name: 2019-2c-parcial2-masked
title: Seabed Survey Crawler: Repeated Commands, Sonar and Guarded Runs
description: A seabed survey crawler that processes command strings (a, t, g, h) with polymorphic facings is given. The student must add single-digit command repetition (digit + 2 times), a sonar with firm sand/silt/boulder ground types that change or forbid movement, and a parenthesized 'guarded run' state that undoes all movements when anything fails inside it.

design.notes: Three orthogonal features interact: ground types must become polymorphic objects returned by an injected sonar (with randomness on silt to control in tests), guarded/free processing is a state machine with parenthesis parsing and nested/unterminated error cases, and undo requires recording inverse movements per facing.
